original.statement: Upgrading to Crossplane v2.0 includes a mandatory operator step, step 4 of the upgrade approach, to upgrade providers.

corrected.statement: Step 4 of the Crossplane v2.0 upgrade guide, "Upgrade providers", applies to environments that install providers through Provider manifests (pkg.crossplane.io Provider), which the guide says to update to provider v2 versions.

decision.reason: [ev-dd988a5ed5c3] tells operators to "update your provider manifests to use v2 versions", so the exposed environments are those that install providers through Provider manifests. Nothing in the evidence mentions a Helm values key `provider.packages`, so that branch is unsupported and makes the condition broader than the evidence allows. [ev-f44aa981165a] is only the table-of-contents entry for this step. The same section also says existing cluster-scoped MRs "continue working unchanged", which matters when judging the consequence, not the exposure.
